about:
Balkowitsch Enterprises, Inc. operates as an online retailer from Bismarck, North Dakota. The company reports 25 years of experience in e-commerce and has served over one million customers since its inception.

The company sells a wide range of health, medical, and wellness products through its e-commerce platform, including dermatology devices such as polarized dermatoscopes, electric and pressure sterilizers, wearable breast pumps, diabetic crew socks, and heart rate sensors. Inventory is sourced from brands including 3Gen, Tuttnauer, Wayne Metal Products, WellBox, All American, Dr. Clark, Zomee, Creswell Sock Mills, and Polar.

Its customer base spans medical professionals, healthcare facilities, and individual consumers seeking products for dermatology, sterilization, lactation support, diabetic care, and fitness monitoring. The company serves industries including medical supplies, healthcare, wellness, beauty, fitness, and personal care.

Balkowitsch Enterprises states its vision is to become a global leader in the online distribution of health and medical products, emphasizing technology, innovation, competitive pricing, and direct access to premium products to improve customers' lives.
